method: Actual authored hidden garment donor replaces exact shared stool regions; all current face/hands/lid unchanged. No body transform or alpha-only erasure. v2 removes ordinary-work holds and full high-angle close detours; source images unchanged.
windowMovement: Immediate from pickup; never wait for recovery/closing.

currentPoseEntries.acceptance: static detached source geometry checked; shortened supported recovery pending representative interactive review
currentPoseEntries.releaseDuringRecovery: If current recovery exposure has originalSeatedSource, restore that exact current supported seated equivalent at world-seat contact. For named pickup frames use that frame releaseNext. Never resume a stale grab queue.
currentPoseEntries.recoveryPolicy: Short current operator release + real gaze bridge, each authored exposure <=45ms; acquire supported open-lid pose and enter half-lid pickup. Never queue the ordinary full seated close cycle.
